paragraphs.source_en: “Third, I hope that the Lord of the Inner府’s entry into the castle will persuade Jibu to abandon his resistance. I understand what is in Jibu’s heart. But so long as he persists in his obstinacy, the Taikō’s former retainers will split into two camps and slaughter one another. That is what worries me most.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “第三，我希望内府进城，能够使治部放弃反抗。治部的心思我明白。可是，只要其仍旧执著，太阁旧臣就会分裂成两派，互相残杀。这才是我最担心的。”

paragraphs.source_en: Tears fell from Nagamasa’s eyes before he knew it. He felt himself bathed in radiant light and a fragrance that refreshed the very heart, drifting in rapture as though he had entered the Pure Land, with exquisite music sounding in his ears and weightless petals dancing all around him…

units.source_zh: 他只觉沐浴在朗朗光辉与沁人心脾的气息中，陶醉着，徜徉着，仿佛进入了极乐世界，耳边传来美妙的乐声，轻盈的花瓣在身边飞舞……

paragraphs.source_zh: 长政不觉掉下泪来。他只觉沐浴在朗朗光辉与沁人心脾的气息中，陶醉着，徜徉着，仿佛进入了极乐世界，耳边传来美妙的乐声，轻盈的花瓣在身边飞舞……

paragraphs.source_en: To bring Jibu to his senses, Nagamasa too must now act decisively. Since he could not contend with Ieyasu, he should withdraw without hesitation—and tactfully convey Kōdai-in’s wishes to Maeda Toshinaga as well. Once Jibu was allowed to provoke a conflict, events would unfold just as Kōdai-in had said: the Taikō’s former retainers would splinter and slaughter one another, further weakening the Toyotomi clan…

paragraphs.source_zh: 为了让治部觉醒，长政也该果断采取行动了。既无法与家康抗衡，就该断然隐退，还要巧妙地把高台院之意转告前田利长。一旦让治部挑起事端，局势就会如高台院所言，太阁旧臣将四分五裂、互相杀戮，结果进一步削弱丰臣氏的实力……

paragraphs.source_en: “At last, the dawn has come!” Nagamasa murmured. The instant the words left his lips, even he was startled: had the sun not only just set?
